description: Eastern Province - By-Laws relating to the Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new by-laws (specifically "By-laws to Regularize, Control and Supervise the Advertisements") for the Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha. It establishes a regulatory framework for advertisement display, including licensing requirements, fees, and compliance rules. While it mentions a government official (Nazeer Ahamed), the core content is about creating legal/regulatory provisions rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it deals with subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks.
